title: Angband 3D — 5-Minute Award-Winning Gameplay Walkthrough
narrator: Master Chronicler Enceladus & Lorekeeper Aoede (Gemini Native Audio)

chapters.title: Act 1: Town of Angband, Armoury & Stair Descent
Act 2: The Crypts, 0-Turn Yaw & Minimap Zoom
Act 3: Seamless Dual Reality & 80x24 CRT Terminal
Act 4: Caverns — Ranged Archery & Message Log Drawer
Act 5: Arcane Vault — Grimoire Sorcery & Potion Quaff
Act 6: Living Chronicle, Voiced Orc Shaman & Lorekeeper
Act 7: Magma Vault — Young Red Dragon & Phase Door
Act 9: Grand Finale — Free, Open Source & Replication

audioStems.speaker: Enceladus
audioStems.text: Thunderbear Studios presents Angband 3D — thirty years of legendary roguelike heritage, completely reborn in a stunning, fully-playable 3D first-person world.

audioStems.speaker: Enceladus
audioStems.text: Welcome to the Town of Angband. Beneath these peaceful cobblestones lies fifty levels of peril and ancient treasure.

audioStems.speaker: Enceladus
audioStems.text: From storefront exploration and street interactions to full first-person equipment management, Angband 3D brings unprecedented depth and atmosphere to classic dungeon crawling.

audioStems.speaker: Enceladus
audioStems.text: Descending into the shallow crypts, dynamic torchlight illuminates vaulted halls. Seamless camera turning offers instant situational awareness with zero game turn penalty.

audioStems.speaker: Enceladus
audioStems.text: The interactive tactical minimap keeps your bearings razor-sharp as you slay foes and claim valuable dungeon loot.

audioStems.speaker: Enceladus
audioStems.text: Every single roll, stat, and mechanic is 100% faithful to authoritative Angband C engine rules.

audioStems.speaker: Enceladus
audioStems.text: With a single tap of the Tab key, toggle instantly between modern 3D first-person rendering and the legendary 80x24 green-screen CRT terminal — seamlessly synchronized in real time.

audioStems.speaker: Enceladus
audioStems.text: Deeper in the caverns, long-range tactical combat comes alive. Draw your bow and let fly arrows down winding corridors with fluid 3D projectile targeting.

audioStems.speaker: Enceladus
audioStems.text: While the expandable message log drawer delivers full tactical combat telemetry at your fingertips.

audioStems.speaker: Enceladus
audioStems.text: Master the arcane arts with authentic grimoire spellcasting. Channel Magic Missiles and unleash elemental bursts against dark sorcerers.

audioStems.speaker: Enceladus
audioStems.text: And quaff restorative elixirs in the heat of battle to survive the darkest depths.

audioStems.speaker: Enceladus
audioStems.text: Available exclusively on the web edition, the Living Chronicle is your interactive AI lore companion.

audioStems.speaker: Fenrir (Orc Shaman)
audioStems.text: Back, surface dog! Douse that torch or my curses will rend your flesh before you reach the stairs!

audioStems.speaker: Aoede (Lorekeeper)
audioStems.text: Heed well, traveler: dragon breath ignores common armor. Wield rings of Resist Heat, and keep scrolls of Phase Door ready to break line of sight!

audioStems.speaker: Enceladus
audioStems.text: In the deepest magma vaults, survival demands every ounce of strategy. Trade blows with towering dragons, and leverage elemental resistances.

audioStems.speaker: Enceladus
audioStems.text: Trigger phase door escapes when the flames burn too close, turning the tide of battle in an instant.

audioStems.speaker: Enceladus
audioStems.text: Your adventures are entirely your own. With universal save file export, take your character save file seamlessly between the browser, native desktop clients, and classic terminal Angband with 100% interoperability.

audioStems.speaker: Enceladus
audioStems.text: Angband 3D is 100% free and open source. Play now directly in your browser at angband3d dot com, inspect the source, host your own server, and build the future of roguelikes. Brought to you by Thunderbear Studios.
